title: Shakeout 30min + THE MONDAY KNEE GATE
terrain: flat road or firm sand, no camber
coachNotes:
EXECUTION: 30min easy, flat, no camber. Turn around halfway. This is the restorative session, not a workout - if it feels like effort you are running it wrong.
GYM: hip abductor block as on 30 Aug. Side-lying abduction 3x15/side, clamshells 3x15/side, single-leg glute bridges 3x12/side, side plank with top-leg abduction 3x30s/side, Copenhagen 3x20s/side. Still no step-downs, split squats or lunges.
FUEL: none needed. Water only.
STOP RULE / THE GATE: this morning's knee report decides 5 September. Check it on waking, before the run: stairs, first steps, sitting-to-standing. Clean this morning AND clean on 27-30 Aug confirms 5 Sep at 1600m D+ with the descent capped at 1000m, load 195. Any lateral knee pain that appears during a run and worsens with duration, or a knee that reports on waking today, drops 5 Sep back to 900m D+ / 600m D- / load 130 and I revert the plan the same day.
WHY: this is the last data point taken before the decision, and the first one fully outside the shockwave analgesic window at 5 days post-treatment. It is the honest reading.
